global_style: A minimalist, elegant presentation system featuring Morandi gradient backgrounds, translucent frosted-glass panels, and highly structured typographic layouts.

identity_anchors: Dusty rose to sage green continuous background gradients.
Translucent white framing panels creating a subtle glassmorphism effect.
Large, high-contrast structural typography (numerals and section headers).
Rotated vertical watermark typography on the margins.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
